title: Brand Deals (per talent)
description: Per-talent file capturing the rich record of every brand campaign the talent has done. One file per talent at `data/brand_deals/{talent_id}.json` (folder gitignored — commercial KPI data and exact fees shouldn't be in the repo). Powers: Brand Discovery Search 1 (re-engagement timing), Pitch Angles (5 KPI-driven angles + enrichment of 3 existing), Outreach AI generation (citation material in pitch prompts), and Contact Enrichment (warm-intro candidate identification). See `docs/brand_deals_workflow.md`.

agency_id.description: Multi-tenant scope: FK to agency_profile.agency_id. Optional in v0.1 (single-tenant deploys may omit); required in v2 SaaS. When present, all cross-record queries MUST filter by agency_id to prevent cross-tenant data leakage. See docs/data_lineage.md GAP-01/02 for rationale.

talent_id.description: Slug matching the `id` in the source `talents/{id}.json`.

deals.description: All known brand campaigns for this talent — past + active + upcoming. Sorted newest first by convention.

deal.description: One brand campaign. KPI fields each carry source provenance per the honesty-floor policy — never fabricate. Re-engagement metadata captured separately so Search 1 of Brand Discovery has everything it needs without parsing dates.

brand_name.description: Denormalised display name for at-a-glance reading. Source of truth remains `brand_industry_map.json`.

industry_id.description: FK to `data/industries.json`. Denormalised from brand_industry_map at deal-creation time.

campaign_name.description: Brand's name for the campaign (e.g. 'Lift Collection Launch', 'Holiday 2025').

campaign_type.description: Deal structure type. sponsored_post = single piece; sponsored_series = multi-post campaign; ambassador = long-term recurring; product_seeding = gifted product, no fee; affiliate = commission-based; ugc_license = brand licenses talent content; whitelisting = talent content used as brand paid social; paid_appearance = event/panel/host; brand_integration = paid mention in non-sponsored content; co_branded_product = co-creation.

campaign_objective.description: Brand's stated goal for the campaign. Drives which KPIs matter most for the post-campaign analysis.

posted_dates.description: Specific dates when content was posted. Used for time-on-feed analysis and post-by-post KPI breakdowns.

deliverables.description: What the talent agreed to produce.

post_urls.description: Direct URLs to the published content. Useful for verification + showing the brand the work.

fee_usd.description: Total fee converted to USD. May be 0 for product_seeding deals.

category.description: Industry / category the talent was exclusive in.

additional_compensation.description: Non-cash compensation: gifted product, event invites, equity, comped travel.

kpis.description: Quantitative results. Every metric carries source provenance. Omit metrics with no confident value.

vs_industry_benchmark.description: Per-KPI comparison against industry benchmarks. SCHEMA SHIPS IN v0.1 but population requires `data/industry_kpi_benchmarks.json` which is deferred to v2 — until then, this object stays empty. When benchmarks data ships, the orchestrator computes these comparisons automatically from `kpis.*` against the benchmark file.

performance_label.description: Human-readable summary, e.g. '2.3x category', '+29% vs category', 'top 10%'.

audience_overlap_with_brand_target_pct.description: Estimated percentage of the talent's audience that matches the brand's target customer profile. Computed at campaign-end from IAB segment overlap + any brand-provided audience-match data.

audience_demographics_at_campaign_time.description: Snapshot of the talent's audience_demographics. Snapshot timing convention (v0.1): captured at auto-archive time, NOT at campaign-end. This is best-effort — audience_demographics may have evolved between campaign-end and archive (typically a 30-90d window). For precise campaign-end demographics, downstream tooling can cross-reference `deal.delivery.interim_kpi_snapshots[]` capture timestamps + a future audience-demographics snapshot store. Same shape as `talent.audience_demographics`. See `docs/data_lineage.md` GAP-13.

performance_notes.description: Free-text qualitative summary. What worked, what didn't, brand feedback, lessons learned. Used as context by the email generator when citing this campaign.

outcome.description: Overall outcome classification. successful_renewed = brand renewed for follow-on campaign; successful = completed cleanly, no renewal; mixed = some KPIs hit, some missed; underperformed = KPIs missed by >20%; unfulfilled = campaign didn't complete (talent or brand pulled out).

case_study_url.description: Optional public URL of the campaign case study (often on the brand or agency website). Powers the `case_study_available` pitch angle.

do_not_recontact.description: Hard flag. When true, Brand Discovery Search 1 (re-engagement) will never surface this brand for this talent. Set after a soured deal or explicit 'don't come back' from the brand.

cool_down_override_days.description: Days to wait before this brand is eligible for re-engagement. Null = use default 180 days from ended_at. Set per-deal to honour brand-specific cadences (e.g. 'come back in March' = explicit date).

last_re_engagement_pitch_date.description: When we last sent a re-engagement pitch to this brand for this talent. Used to extend cool-down on no-response (anti-spam — see Brand Discovery Search 1 § De-spam).

renewal_eligibility_date.description: Computed: ended_at + cool_down_override_days (or default 180). Null while campaign is `pending`. The orchestrator updates this whenever ended_at or cool_down_override_days changes.

main_brand_contact_id.description: FK to a contact_id in `data/brand_contacts/{brand_id}.json`. The person at the brand who ran this campaign. Powers warm-intro identification — when this person changes brands, we know we have a warm relationship to leverage.

agency_contact_id.description: FK if the deal went through an agency-of-record. Contact at the AOR brand_id.

originated_from_pitch_enrollment_id.description: Optional FK to `data/pitch_enrollments/{enrollment_id}.json` if this deal originated from a pitch our outreach engine sent. Closes the loop: we can compute 'reply → deal' conversion rates by talent / template / angle for the analytics layer.

archived_from_deal_id.description: Optional FK to the Phase 4 pipeline deal (`data/deals/{deal_id}.json`) that this historical brand_deal was auto-archived from. Closes the bidirectional link: the pipeline deal's `close.archived_to_brand_deal_id` points here, and this field points back. Anyone reviewing this archived deal can navigate to the full pipeline history.

data_sources.description: Which sources contributed data to this record. Honesty-floor: every populated KPI's `source` should be reflected here.

manually_verified_by_talent.description: Whether the talent has reviewed and confirmed the data. Distinguishes AI-extracted-but-unreviewed from talent-verified records. Email generator weights verified records higher when citing metrics.

notes.description: Free-text internal notes (agency-side). Not surfaced to brand contacts.

kpiMetric.$comment: Canonical definition at schemas/_shared/kpi_metric.schema.json. This wrapper preserves the local #/$defs/kpiMetric reference path used elsewhere in this schema.
